command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP 1: install zram-generator ==="
sudo -n dnf install -y zram-generator

echo "=== STEP 2: configure zram-generator.conf ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf >/dev/null <<'EOF'
[zram0]
zram-size = max(ram / 2, 512)
compression-algorithm = zstd
swap-priority = 100
fs-type = swap
EOF
cat /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf

echo "=== STEP 3: reload systemd and start zram-generator unit ==="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl start systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
sleep 2

echo "=== STEP 4: verify swap active ==="
swapon --show
free -h
echo "=== STEP 5: verify device size and compression ==="
cat /sys/block/zram0/disksize
cat /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm
cat /sys/block/zram0/mm_stat || true

echo "=== STEP 6: verify unit enabled/active for boot persistence ==="
systemctl is-enabled systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service || true
systemctl is-active systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
systemctl status systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service --no-pager || true
